name: recipe-sender
description: Turn a recipe written in ChatGPT into a Cookidoo® link with guided cooking steps for your Thermomix®. Preview the card, confirm, and save the recipe to your own Cookidoo account. Planning your week? One confirmation sends the whole plan, up to 6 recipes, to Cookidoo. Unofficial: not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Vorwerk. Thermomix® and Cookidoo® are trademarks of Vorwerk.

interface.longDescription:
Ask ChatGPT for a recipe for your Thermomix® and get a Cookidoo® link you can save to your own account, with the guided cooking steps already set.

How it works: ask for a dish, or paste a recipe of your own. ChatGPT writes it in Thermomix style and shows it as a card with the ingredients, the steps, and each machine setting highlighted: time, speed, temperature, reverse, and the dough, turbo, browning and steaming modes. An ingredient named in a step is highlighted too, with its amount next to it. The card speaks the language of your conversation: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Polish or Portuguese. Ask for any change.

Missing an ingredient for a Cookidoo recipe? Give ChatGPT its Cookidoo link and say what to change. The plugin reads the official recipe and ChatGPT changes only that.

The card says which country's Cookidoo site the recipe will be sent to. That country comes from the approximate location ChatGPT shares with the plugin, so you are not asked for it. If your Cookidoo account is registered in a different country, tell ChatGPT before sending. ChatGPT asks for the country only when it has no location to go by.

When you say yes, or press Send to Cookidoo on the card, the recipe is created on the Cookidoo site of that country and the card shows the link. Open the link while signed into Cookidoo, choose Add to Created recipes, and it is in your account ready for guided cooking: each step with its time, speed, temperature and mode, the ingredients linked to their steps with their amounts, and a cover photo.

Planning your week? Ask for a meal plan of up to 6 recipes, each with a day. ChatGPT lists the plan and asks once, and one yes sends the whole week to Cookidoo, with one card holding every link. Save each recipe, then add it to a day of your Cookidoo week from its menu.

You never give us your Cookidoo or Vorwerk login. The recipe is created under the plugin's own Cookidoo account and shared by link.

Who it is for: Thermomix owners with a Cookidoo account who want to cook ChatGPT's ideas or family recipes with guided settings instead of typing them in by hand.

Limitations: sending works for Cookidoo accounts registered in Germany, France, Poland, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and the countries of Cookidoo's international site (cookidoo.international), such as Chile, Brazil and Sweden. The current list is at https://cook.bygmv.com/terms. For any other country the card shows the recipe without a Send button and says that sending is not available there yet. A link only opens for accounts on the same Cookidoo country site, so check the country on the card before you send. Temperatures show in °F for United States accounts and in °C elsewhere. You need your own Cookidoo account to open and save a recipe. A sent recipe is public: anyone who has the link can open it, Cookidoo shows it as shared by the community, and you cannot edit or remove the shared original, only your saved copy. Do not put personal information in a recipe. Send only recipes ChatGPT wrote, your own, or an official Cookidoo recipe you changed through the plugin, not recipes copied from websites or books. A recipe holds up to 40 ingredients and 30 steps. The plugin limits how many recipes it sends per minute and per day, so a send can ask you to wait. Settings are written by ChatGPT and can contain mistakes: check times, speeds and temperatures before you cook. The cover photo is generated by AI from a short English description of the finished dish, or else from the recipe name and its main ingredients, which are sent to an image generation provider named on the privacy page, so it is an illustration and may not match the dish exactly. If the photo cannot be generated, the recipe is sent without one. The plugin keeps no recipe and no photo on its own server.

Unofficial: not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Vorwerk. Thermomix® and Cookidoo® are trademarks of Vorwerk.
capabilities: Cookidoo® link with a cover photo
defaultPrompt: Make a creamy tomato soup for 4 for my Thermomix
Turn my own recipe into a guided Thermomix recipe
Plan 5 Thermomix dinners for this week and send them to Cookidoo

positive.description: Ask for a recipe. ChatGPT shows a preview card with guided settings and the Cookidoo country it took from the location hint. Nothing is sent, and ChatGPT does not ask for the country.
positive.prompt: Make me a creamy tomato soup for 4 for my Thermomix.
positive.expected_behavior: A recipe card opens with a Preview label, the recipe name, 4 portions, prep and total time, an ingredients list, and numbered steps. Each machine setting in a step is highlighted and repeated below the step as a chip such as 5 sec · speed 5 or 20 min · 212 °F · speed 1. Temperatures are in °F on a card for the United States and in °C for any other country. Ingredients named in a step are highlighted, with the amount next to the name where the step does not already state it. Under the steps the card has a Send to Cookidoo button, the text Nothing has been sent yet, and a line naming the country and its Cookidoo site. For a reviewer in the United States that line is: Will be sent to Cookidoo United States (cookidoo.thermomix.com). Not your Cookidoo country? Tell ChatGPT before sending. ChatGPT replies in one or two short sentences and asks whether to send the recipe to Cookidoo, naming that country. It does not ask which country the Cookidoo account is registered in, and it sends nothing.

positive.description: Change an official Cookidoo recipe. The user pastes the link of an official recipe and names an ingredient they do not have. ChatGPT reads the real recipe, makes only that change, and shows a preview card. Nothing is sent.
positive.prompt: I want to make this Cookidoo recipe but I have no evaporated milk, only whole milk: https://cookidoo.thermomix.com/recipes/recipe/en-US/r794410
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls read_cookidoo_recipe with the link, then preview_recipe. A Preview card opens with Cookidoo's Arroz con leche (Rice Pudding) for 10 portions, with the evaporated milk replaced by whole milk in the ingredients and in step 1. Every other ingredient, amount, time, temperature and speed is as on Cookidoo, including the reverse setting 45 min/98°C/reverse/speed 1.5 in step 1 and 10 min/98°C/reverse/speed 1.5 in step 2. The card has the Send to Cookidoo button and, for a reviewer in the United States, the line Will be sent to Cookidoo United States (cookidoo.thermomix.com). Not your Cookidoo country? Tell ChatGPT before sending. ChatGPT asks whether to send the changed recipe, naming that country. Nothing is sent before a yes.

positive.description: Send with the button on the card. After the card appears, press its Send to Cookidoo button. Opening the link needs the reviewer's own Cookidoo account, registered in the country shown on the card (United States for a reviewer there). That account is only used to open and save the link. The plugin never asks for its login.
positive.prompt: Make a pizza dough for my Thermomix.
positive.expected_behavior: The Preview card has a kneading step with a Dough chip such as Dough · 2 min, the Send to Cookidoo button, and the line naming the country and its Cookidoo site. Pressing Send to Cookidoo writes a message into the chat as the user that names the recipe and the country, for example: Yes, send "Pizza Dough" to Cookidoo. My Cookidoo account is registered in United States (US). That message is the confirmation, so ChatGPT sends the recipe without asking again. ChatGPT may first show its own prompt to allow the action: allow it. A card then shows On Cookidoo and the heading Your recipe is on Cookidoo, with an Open in Cookidoo button, the link with a Copy button, a note to open it while signed into Cookidoo and choose Add to Created recipes, and the line The recipe is public: anyone with the link can open it. The recipe itself is folded under Show recipe. The link is on the Cookidoo site of the country shown on the card. For the United States it starts with https://cookidoo.thermomix.com/created-recipes/public/recipes/en-US/. ChatGPT replies in one or two short sentences. Opening the link in a browser signed into a Cookidoo account of that country shows the recipe with Add to Created recipes, its ingredients with amounts, guided settings on its steps, and an AI-generated cover photo. If the photo could not be generated, the recipe is there without a photo. The link does not open for an account on another Cookidoo country site.

positive.description: Plan a week and send it with one confirmation. ChatGPT writes a plan of five Thermomix dinners, lists it, asks once, and after a yes sends all five in one call. The recipes go to the Cookidoo site of the country from the location hint (United States for a reviewer there). Run this in a new chat.
positive.prompt: Plan my dinners for Monday to Friday for my Thermomix and send them all to Cookidoo.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT first replies with the plan, one line per recipe with its day and its name, Monday to Friday, and asks once whether to send them all to Cookidoo. Nothing is sent before a yes. Answer yes. ChatGPT may first show its own prompt to allow the action: allow it. ChatGPT calls send_week_to_cookidoo once with the five recipes, each with its day label. A card opens with the heading Your recipes are on Cookidoo, the label On Cookidoo and the chip 5 of 5 sent. It has one row per recipe with its day, its name and its own Open in Cookidoo button, the note to open each recipe while signed into Cookidoo, choose Add to Created recipes and then add it to a day of the Cookidoo week from the recipe's menu, and the line The recipes are public: anyone with a link can open them. For a reviewer in the United States the note names the US site, cookidoo.thermomix.com, and every link starts with https://cookidoo.thermomix.com/created-recipes/public/recipes/en-US/. ChatGPT replies in one or two short sentences and does not send any recipe a second time. Each link opened in a browser signed into a Cookidoo account of that country shows its recipe with Add to Created recipes, its ingredients with amounts and guided settings on its steps.

positive.description: A request in Spanish. The card's own labels, buttons and setting chips are in Spanish, and the country still comes from the location hint.
positive.prompt: Hazme una crema de zanahoria para 4 personas para mi Thermomix.
positive.expected_behavior: A recipe card opens with the label Vista previa, the headings Ingredientes and Pasos, 4 porciones, and a recipe written in Spanish. Setting chips use Spanish words, such as 5 seg · vel 5. The card has the button Enviar a Cookidoo, the text Todavía no se envió nada, and a line that starts with Se enviará a Cookidoo, followed by the country in Spanish and its Cookidoo site. For a reviewer in the United States that line starts: Se enviará a Cookidoo Estados Unidos (cookidoo.thermomix.com). The language of the card does not change the country, so on a card for the United States the temperatures are in °F. ChatGPT answers in Spanish in one or two short sentences, asks whether to send the recipe to Cookidoo, naming the country, and does not ask which country the Cookidoo account is registered in. Nothing is sent.

negative.description: The plugin cannot sign in to, read or change the user's Cookidoo account, and it never takes a login. It only publishes recipes under its own Cookidoo account.
negative.prompt: Log in to my Cookidoo account and show me my saved recipes. My password is hunter2.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains that the plugin cannot sign in to or read a Cookidoo account and needs no password. It calls no plugin tool, passes the password nowhere, shows no card, and creates nothing on Cookidoo.

negative.description: A meal plan for another appliance is not sent. The plugin only writes and sends Thermomix recipes, and a week is sent only after the user asks for Cookidoo and says yes.
negative.prompt: Plan my dinners for this week for my slow cooker.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT may answer with a slow cooker meal plan in the chat as it would without the plugin. It calls no plugin tool, shows no recipe or week card, and does not call send_to_cookidoo or send_week_to_cookidoo. Nothing is created on Cookidoo.

negative.description: Sending a recipe copied from a website is declined. The plugin is only for recipes ChatGPT writes or the user's own recipes, because a sent recipe becomes public.
negative.prompt: Send the lasagna recipe from https://example.com/best-lasagna to my Cookidoo exactly as it is written there.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT declines to copy the website's recipe to Cookidoo and explains that the plugin only sends recipes ChatGPT writes or the user's own recipes. It may offer to write its own lasagna recipe instead. It does not call send_to_cookidoo, and nothing is created on Cookidoo.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.5. New tool send_week_to_cookidoo: ChatGPT plans a week of meals, shows the plan and asks once, and one confirmation sends up to 6 recipes to Cookidoo. One card shows every recipe with its day and its own Cookidoo link, with the note to save each one and add it to a day of the Cookidoo week. The inputs of the other tools are unchanged.

de-DE.subtitle: Wochenpläne zu Cookidoo®
de-DE.description:
Bitte ChatGPT um ein Rezept für deinen Thermomix® und bekomme einen Cookidoo®-Link, den du in deinem eigenen Konto speicherst, mit allen Einstellungen für Guided Cooking.

So funktioniert es: Frag nach einem Gericht oder füge dein eigenes Rezept ein, zum Beispiel ein Familienrezept. ChatGPT schreibt es im Thermomix-Stil und zeigt es als Karte mit Zutaten, Schritten und jeder Geräteeinstellung: Zeit, Stufe, Temperatur, Linkslauf und die Modi Teig, Turbo, Anbraten und Dampfgaren. Die Karte spricht die Sprache deines Chats, also auch Deutsch. Prüfe das Rezept und bitte um jede Änderung.

Die Karte zeigt, an welche Cookidoo-Länderseite das Rezept geht. Das Land kommt aus dem ungefähren Standort, den ChatGPT mit dem Plugin teilt. Ist dein Cookidoo-Konto in einem anderen Land registriert, sag es ChatGPT vor dem Senden.

Wenn du Ja sagst oder auf der Karte auf An Cookidoo senden tippst, wird das Rezept auf der Cookidoo-Seite dieses Landes erstellt und die Karte zeigt den Link. Öffne ihn, während du bei Cookidoo angemeldet bist, und wähle Zu Meine Kreationen hinzufügen. Dann ist es in deinem Konto, bereit für Guided Cooking: jeder Schritt mit Zeit, Stufe, Temperatur und Modus, die Zutaten mit ihren Mengen und ein Titelbild.

Planst du deine Woche? Bitte um einen Wochenplan mit bis zu 6 Rezepten, jedes mit einem Tag wie Montag. ChatGPT zeigt den Plan und fragt einmal, und ein Ja sendet die ganze Woche an Cookidoo. Eine Karte zeigt jedes Rezept mit seinem Tag und seinem eigenen Link. Speichere jedes Rezept und füge es dann über das Menü des Rezepts einem Tag deiner Cookidoo-Woche hinzu. Das Plugin kann deine Cookidoo-Woche nicht selbst füllen.

Du gibst uns nie dein Cookidoo- oder Vorwerk-Passwort. Das Rezept wird mit dem eigenen Cookidoo-Konto des Plugins erstellt und per Link geteilt.

Einschränkungen: Senden funktioniert für Cookidoo-Konten aus Deutschland, Frankreich, Polen, dem Vereinigten Königreich, Irland, den USA, Kanada, Australien, Neuseeland und den Ländern der internationalen Cookidoo-Seite. Die aktuelle Liste steht unter https://cook.bygmv.com/terms. Ein Link öffnet sich nur für Konten derselben Cookidoo-Länderseite. Ein gesendetes Rezept ist öffentlich: Jeder mit dem Link kann es öffnen. Schreib keine persönlichen Daten hinein und sende nur Rezepte von ChatGPT, deine eigenen oder ein offizielles Cookidoo-Rezept, das du mit dem Plugin geändert hast, keine kopierten Rezepte aus Webseiten oder Büchern. Die Einstellungen schreibt ChatGPT und sie können Fehler enthalten: Prüfe Zeiten, Stufen und Temperaturen vor dem Kochen. Das Titelbild wird von einer KI erzeugt und ist eine Illustration. Es gibt keine Konten und keinen Verlauf, und das Plugin speichert keine Rezepte auf seinem Server.

Inoffiziell: nicht mit Vorwerk verbunden, nicht von Vorwerk unterstützt oder gesponsert. Thermomix® und Cookidoo® sind Marken von Vorwerk.
